game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Frost Peaks – Peak Beacon, the beacon on the peak: the sherpa guide must handle ice hawks while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Palindrome Gate: Check whether a word reads the same backward to open the gate.
theme: Frost Peaks – Peak Beacon: the beacon on the peak
core_gameplay_loop: In Peak Beacon, repeat each round: Check whether a word reads the same backward to open the gate. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the gate value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Chain 10 consecutive correct decisions about gate to power up the sherpa guide and open the radio mast.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 6 (applied tier): Palindrome Gate
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Palindrome Gate' (Week 8 slot 5), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Peak Beacon'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how gate changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ice hawks in Peak Beacon.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 10.
